comment: The page must be revalidated on every load, not served from the browser's
own cache. Everything here lives in one HTML file — the client book parser,
the roster, the pods — so a browser holding an old copy of index.html is
holding an old copy of the entire dashboard. That looks exactly like stale
data from the sheet, which is the wrong place to go looking, and it hides
every deploy until someone happens to hard-reload.
no-cache does not mean do not store: the browser still keeps the file and
still asks whether it changed, so an unchanged page costs a 304 and no
download. Only /api is left alone — api/data.js sets its own caching.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; connect-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
